dataset_name: 120 illustrative records covering five faults and four condition buckets

records.title: Stale obstacle perception (day dry)
records.description: Camera failure can leave obstacle perception stale. Operating condition: day dry.

records.title: Camera failure: response 1
records.description: Suspend autonomous travel and request a controlled stop when camera perception is unavailable. Operating condition: day dry.

records.title: Camera failure: check 1
records.description: Inject camera failure and check that the controller requests a controlled stop. Operating condition: day dry.

records.title: Unavailable visual route cues (day dry)
records.description: Camera failure can prevent recognition of visual route cues. Operating condition: day dry.

records.title: Camera failure: response 2
records.description: Pause route execution when required visual route cues are unavailable. Operating condition: day dry.

records.title: Camera failure: check 2
records.description: Remove camera route cues and verify that route execution pauses. Operating condition: day dry.

records.title: Loss of remote supervision (day dry)

records.title: Communication loss: response 1
records.description: Request a controlled stop when the communication watchdog expires. Operating condition: day dry.

records.title: Communication loss: check 1
records.description: Disconnect communication and verify the configured watchdog stop request. Operating condition: day dry.

records.title: Unavailable remote intervention (day dry)
records.description: Communication loss can prevent delivery of remote intervention commands. Operating condition: day dry.

records.title: Communication loss: response 2
records.description: Disable continued autonomous travel when the required supervision link is unavailable. Operating condition: day dry.

records.title: Communication loss: check 2
records.description: Interrupt the supervision link and verify that continued travel is disabled. Operating condition: day dry.

records.title: Extended stopping travel (day dry)
records.description: Reduced traction can increase travel during a stop request. Operating condition: day dry.

records.title: Reduced traction: response 1
records.description: Apply the documented reduced-traction operating limits and request a controlled stop. Operating condition: day dry.

records.title: Reduced traction: check 1
records.description: Simulate reduced traction and check the configured operating-limit and stop requests. Operating condition: day dry.

records.title: Loss of path tracking (day dry)
records.description: Reduced traction can cause deviation from the planned path. Operating condition: day dry.

records.title: Reduced traction: response 2
records.description: Pause autonomous travel when traction monitoring indicates path tracking cannot be maintained. Operating condition: day dry.

records.title: Reduced traction: check 2
records.description: Inject a traction fault and verify the path-tracking monitor pause request. Operating condition: day dry.

records.title: Delayed obstacle response (day dry)
records.description: Processing delay can cause obstacle decisions to use stale sensor information. Operating condition: day dry.

records.title: Processing delay: response 1
records.description: Request a controlled stop when sensor processing exceeds the configured freshness limit. Operating condition: day dry.

records.title: Processing delay: check 1
records.description: Inject processing delay and verify the freshness-monitor stop request. Operating condition: day dry.

records.title: Delayed navigation updates (day dry)
records.description: Processing delay can leave navigation commands based on outdated position information. Operating condition: day dry.

records.title: Processing delay: response 2
records.description: Pause navigation when position updates exceed the configured age limit. Operating condition: day dry.

records.title: Processing delay: check 2
records.description: Delay position processing and verify that navigation pauses at the configured age limit. Operating condition: day dry.
